title: Studying Under Pressure
text:
Many students find it difficult to stay motivated during long exam periods. Some of them study late into the night, which often leads to exhaustion. A better approach is to divide the material into small, manageable goals.

Teachers can help by offering regular feedback and encouraging breaks. Such support is particularly valuable for students who feel anxious about their results. As a result, many learners become more confident and perform better.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, what often happens to students who study late into the night?
What can teachers offer, according to the second paragraph?
options: Regular feedback and encouragement to take breaks

questions.text: What can be inferred about students who feel anxious about their results?
options: They are unlikely to need any support
They may benefit most from teacher support
They usually perform worse than everyone else
They prefer to study alone at night

questions.text: Why does the writer suggest dividing the material into small goals?
options: To finish the exam before others
To avoid reading the full text
To reduce the number of exams
To make the workload feel more manageable

vocabulary.definition: a state of being extremely tired and without energy
small or simple enough to deal with easily
worried or nervous about something that may happen

paragraph_translations: Wielu uczniów uważa, że trudno jest zachować motywację w czasie długich sesji egzaminacyjnych. Niektórzy z nich uczą się do późnej nocy, co często prowadzi do wyczerpania. Lepszym podejściem jest podzielenie materiału na małe, łatwe do opanowania cele.

Nauczyciele mogą pomóc, oferując regularną informację zwrotną i zachęcając do przerw. Takie wsparcie jest szczególnie cenne dla uczniów, którzy odczuwają niepokój o wyniki. W rezultacie wielu uczniów staje się pewniejszych siebie i osiąga lepsze wyniki.
